Not available for online ordering. About Our Fine Dining & Us Lively music, a vibrant crowd, inventive cocktails and the best sushi in  Gulf Shores. You know when you’re in Mikato Japanese Steakhouse because  there’s no other place like it. Order up the freshest sushi caught  daily from the Gulf. Delight in our signature rolls or amazing Japanese  fusion cuisine. Whatever you choose, it’s all served with a big side of  Anything Can Happen. So bring your friends or make new ones. Either way,  you’re in for a great time.  Cocktail BarCocktail BarCocktail Bar Experience rare spirits and handcrafted cocktails curated uniquely for your taste.HibachiCocktail BarCocktail Bar Hibachi-style has come to signify grilled Japanese-style cuisine, the  grills they’re cooked on, and even the restaurants themselves. SushiCocktail BarSushi Sushi, the artful dining experience once uniquely Japanese, has now  evolved to another level beyond the traditional Japanese methods.   View our full dinner menu and call 251.968.2525 to orderReady to order. tap to call or call 251.968.2525 Photo Gallery ReviewsReviews coming soon!
